body.message:
I waited in the apartment until 1 PM, but no one came or knocked on the door. I then checked with reception, and they confirmed that no one from FAM Living had come.

I’ve been waiting downstairs where I can see both the security/lift area and the main reception, and no one has entered or come here. I was in the apartment before and I’m now at reception. So I really don’t understand how they could have come to the building and left without me noticing.
